name: Operator Task

## Task Type

- [ ] Drift Check — compare repo state against Hive catalog
- [ ] Doc Refresh — evaluate and regenerate documentation
- [ ] Content Forge — generate new content from prompts and policies
- [ ] Status Review — assess Node readiness for status transition
- [ ] Other — describe below

## Target

**Node / Repo**: _e.g., HoneyDrunk.Core_
**Sector**: _e.g., Infrastructure_

## Priority

- [ ] Low — next scheduled run is fine
- [ ] Medium — should be addressed within the current cycle
- [ ] High — requires immediate attention

## Description

_What should Operator do? Be specific about the scope, the expected inputs, and any constraints._

## Expected Outcome

_What does success look like? Describe the deliverable — a PR, a drift report, a status proposal, updated docs._

## Additional Context

_Links, references, or background that Operator (or a human reviewer) needs to understand this task._
